item: Stoplist batch 7 (R131, language group 6): 344 function, number and calendar words in am eu fo gl ha kk mk rw sw
key_paths: configs/stopwords_extra/PROVENANCE.md tests/test_analytics_extract.py tests/test_stopword_file_scripts.py scripts/stopword_batch.py configs/stopwords_extra/am.yml configs/stopwords_extra/eu.yml configs/stopwords_extra/kk.yml configs/stopwords_extra/mk.yml configs/stopwords_extra/sw.yml
summary: Sixth T5 batch under the maintainer's go (R131): am 29, eu 56, fo 15, gl 10, ha 25, kk 76, mk 58, rw 14, sw 61 words from the triage's accepted candidates (258 function words, 40 number words, 38 weekday and month names, 8 attribution verbs and button labels) against the same merged log as the earlier groups (sha256 6467504ab8ab); eight of the nine files are new. Every candidate of these languages has a single reader in the triage, so each word was read a second time by hand before it shipped, and the independent read of the diff took eight more out (kk сол and осы, mk кон, eu baita, sw tisa, hawa, kabla, kumi: each a word of another language that a global list would hide there). Left out by hand: am Fulham and the closing-quote forms, eu hamar (the Norwegian town) and elkar (the Basque publisher), ha kuma and inda, kk бес (the Russian demon). The script guard and the tool's map learn Ethiopic and Cyrillic for am, kk and mk. The 344 words are declared in test_analytics_extract. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: Vietnamese for a reader of Vietnamese, and the layout PR.
